Jewish prayer.fact: Its components include Birkot hashachar, Korbanot, Pesukei dezimra, the Shema Yisrael and its blessings, the Amidah, and Tachanun.

Jewish prayer.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Jewish prayer.question: According to the _____, women are generally exempted from obligations that have to be performed at a certain time
